question: How soon after it is started does a Run appear in the list of run records?
pass: Soon enough that a pass never admits the same Run twice; the item's lane and I-21 cover the gap (section 6). As the story, #10, states it, the bound is written before the trial runs: a started Run is in the list of run records within one pass interval. Section 7.3 gives no pass interval as one number; the shortest it sets between passes the clock starts is the relay's tick, every minute or two (P-20's pass), so the bound is 60 seconds. A pass chained straight after another can come sooner; that gap is the lane's, I-21's and I-38's. Measured over at least twenty starts by workflow_dispatch, one at a time: from just before each dispatch request is sent to the first read of the list of the workflow's runs that holds the new run, the list read every 2 seconds. The verdict is fail if any start exceeds 60 seconds, or is not seen at all.

files.content:
# Platform trials P-17 and P-22 (combsmith/software-factory#10): is a run's name set when the run
# is created, even for a run whose job never starts, and how soon after a dispatch is the run in
# the list of the workflow's runs? The name carries the id the dispatch passes in. With runner
# "none" the job asks for a label no runner has, so it waits queued and never starts; the trial
# cancels it. It runs only when dispatched, holds no permission, and reads no secret.
name: p17-p22-run-records
run-name: sf-trial ${{ inputs.id }}

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      id:
        description: The unique id this run is named for
        required: true
        type: string
      runner:
        description: hosted, or none for a job that never starts
        required: true
        type: choice
        options:
          - hosted
          - none

permissions: {}

jobs:
  trial:
    runs-on: ${{ inputs.runner == 'none' && 'sf-trial-p17-no-such-runner' || 'ubuntu-latest' }}
    timeout-minutes: 2
    steps:
      - name: Say only that the job started
        run: echo "started"
